'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Gameplay subpart in {{Quest|Rust, Sword and the Sun}}.
During this quest, you must manage 4 Attributes (Health, Martialism, Willpower and Reputation). If any of those attributes reach 0, a Game Over happens.

==Summary==
It is the day of the final trial, and the stands are filled with spectators. Everyone is eager to witness how a human will rival the strength of Arsinosa. Augusta looks up as Arsinosa appears. Facing the massive guardian of Septimont, she is unsure when the battle will begin. The moment Arsinosa opens her eyes, she immediately charges towards Augusta, who barely manages to deflect the attack even with her trained reflexes. After several exchanges, Augusta seizes an opportunity to land a strike on Arsinosa, but she is almost at her limit. To Augusta's surprise, Arsinosa halts its attack and bows. The audience erupts with thunderous applause, and the girl is raised to the high platform amidst the cheers. Only then does she realize that after gaining Arsinosa's approval, the people of Septimont will make a special exception for her. Augusta will bypass the Great Agon and be crowned "Champion."

==Dialogue ==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Nestor:''' On the eve of the trial, you return to the training grounds once again. While you wait for Cato, you find yourself standing before the familiar wooden post. It has been your most enduring companion in your pursuit of true strength.
:{{DIcon}} Hug it gently.
:{{DIcon}} Cut it down, and leave the past behind.
:'''Cato:''' "Well? Not particularly an easy path, is it? Tell me, what did you learn from this path?"
:{{DIcon}} Strength can instill fear.
:{{DIcon}} Strength can be destructive.
:'''Cato:''' "Strength brings conquest. Such is humanity's oldest rule. Augusta, I'll be there for your last trial, and I will call your name for all to hear."
:{{DIcon}} I will not stop here.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you.
:Back in your room, you stare blankly at your stacked collection of swords. These trophies symbolize strength and conquest, but how will you show them to the world?
:{{DIcon}} (Continue)
:You once heard the tale of a legendary Gladiator. A warrior who would always fuse their opponent's swords with their own after victory. Now, you decide to tread the same path and stand before the smithy.
:{{DIcon}} Stop outside the blacksmith's forge.
:{{DIcon}} Gaze at the flying sparks from the blacksmith's forge.
:You wish to demonstrate your strength, yet now you still seek to do this with power not of your own... Watching the blacksmith's hammer rise and fall, an seemingly impractical idea emerges.
:{{DIcon}} (Continue)
:—In the end, you use your Forte to fuse all the swords into one.
:(Proof of Honor - Forging a great sword)
:{{DIcon}} Grip the heavy sword in your hand.
:{{DIcon}} Feel the power.
:Your Forte never stood out among Resonators. But its seemingly insignificant power is enough to be stronger than the forge fire and hammer swings.
:{{DIcon}} (Continue)
:The day of the final trial has finally arrived. You walk to the arena's center with your "newly forged" sword. The bronze horns blare from atop the twelve stone pillars. All eyes are on you. Everyone is eager to witness how a human will rival the strength of Arsinosa.
:{{DIcon}} Survey your surroundings.
:{{DIcon}} Take a deep breath
:Suddenly, a rumbling roar cut through the noise of the crowd. The nobles' banners flutter and fall. A colossal shadow swallows the sunlight around you Arsinosa appears.
:{{DIcon}} Arsinosa's mountainous size catches your eye.
:{{DIcon}} There's a slight ringing in your ears.
:"It's awake!" A noble shrieked. Arsinosa stands silently opposite you. Slowly, its eyes open, coldly watching you.
:{{DIcon}} Focus and stay alert.
:{{DIcon}} Rest your hand on the hilt.
:With a sudden sweep of her tail, the Lioness shatters the stone pillar. You roll aside, barely dodging the flying debris. A chill seeps through the tear in the cloth of your left shoulder.
:{{DIcon}} Take the initiative.
:{{DIcon}} Take up a defensive stance.
:The screams from the stands are soon drowned by the Lioness's roar. A wave of sound and dust rips past your ears. You can taste blood on your lips and tongue.
:{{DIcon}} Quickly patch yourself up.
:{{DIcon}} Ignore the pain and tend to the wound later.
:Her second attack comes without warning. You barely have time to react before your sword rises to meet her descending paws.
:{{DIcon}} Recall your encounters from previous battles.
:{{DIcon}} This strike shall be my all.
:You manage to withstand Arsinosa's fierce attack, and at the moment it withdraws, seize the opportunity to thrust your blade into the ancient crack in its right foreleg. Golden blood spills the arena.
:{{DIcon}} Steady your breath.
:{{DIcon}} Look up at Arsinosa.
:Arsinosa ceases her attack, her mane brushing against your bloodstained face before she lowers her head. The arena shakes with applause. You hear the crowd chant your name in honor.
:(Summit of Septimont - Gained Arsinosa's acceptance)
:{{DIcon}} I have passed the final trial.
:{{DIcon}} I have gained the Lioness's blessing.
:'''Augusta:''' "The voices... They are..."
:{{DIcon}} Listen to the waves of cheers.
:{{DIcon}} Listen to the waves of cheers.
:'''Septimontian Citizen:''' "O wise and noble Arsinosa, the mighty guardian of Septimont! Bestow upon her the crown of courage and strength!"
:{{DIcon}} Walk up the steps after Arsinosa.
:{{DIcon}} Walk up the steps after Arsinosa.
:'''Septimontian Citizen:''' "When the cries of triumph resonate with the earth, we see the fire of humanity blaze across Septimont."
:{{DIcon}} Wave after wave of applause. The Septimontians salute me as I advance.
:{{DIcon}} Wave after wave of applause. The Septimontians salute me as I advance.
:'''Septimontian Citizen:''' "O sun and moon, witness this extraordinary feat! Witness her epic dedication to Septimont."
:{{DIcon}} Take another step forward.
:{{DIcon}} Take another step forward.
:As the platform rises, you realize that by earning Arsinosa's blessing, you have been granted a privilege.
:{{DIcon}} They are all bowing to me.
:{{DIcon}} They are all bowing to me.
:You are crowned the Champion without the Great Agon. Nevertheless, you have already conquered countless Gladiators with your strength. Under everyone's gaze, glory now bows at your feet.
:{{DIcon}} Silence the crowd.

:[[File:Quest Rust Sword and the Sun - At the Summit of Septimont.png|400px]]
:'''Nestor:''' At last, you stand atop the summit, the "Champion." Only now, with battle-fire cooled in your veins, do your wounds raise their voices in protest.
:'''Nestor:''' You have shattered the decaying order with strength. And through strength, you shall reshape new rules.
:'''Nestor:''' You shall wield Gladiators' valor on the righteous path. You shall allow no more fragile lives to tremble before death. You shall ensure that your homeland's tragedy will forever be undone...
:'''Nestor:''' Yet... should these new rules, forged by might, lose their foundation, will they not fall? A cold whisper of unease coils in your chest...
:'''Nestor:''' Well then, no time for pointless pondering now.
:'''Nestor:''' From this day forward, your sword, your honor, your two lives, shall serve Septimont!

;(Fail)
:Exhaustion takes over. You have given everything, but still cannot defeat Arsinosa. She doesn't spare you another look before turning away. You fall at the center of the arena alone.
:Unable to bear the bone-shattering pain, you fight and stagger, until, at last, you fall on your knees before Arsinosa.
{{Dialogue End}}
